full_judgment: 13. The trial Court also committed error in holding that the suit is bad for defect of parties for non- impleading the vested property authority as defendant but the said view is an wrong approach as because the suit land is not vested property but even then Additional Deputy Commissioner has been impleaded as defendant No.2 'who looks after the vested property on behalf of the government and, as such, the findings of the trial Court is quite irrelevant. Besides no suit can fail merely for non-joinder or misjoinder of parties as per order 1 rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure. In 49 DLR (AD) 151 it is held that "no suit can fail by reason merely of non-joinder of parties Order I Rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure makes this legal position clear". Apart from this, the finding of the trial Court that the plaintiff being not in possession of the suit land his suit is not maintainable without making prayer of khas possession is also not maintainable, since the property is in the possession of the Government, the plaintiffs suit is maintainable without making prayer for recovery of khas possession.
